authored_numeric_startswith_7_1.query:
select c.node_id,c.companyName,count(t.node_id) flCount,count(distinct t.node_id) distinctTdocDiagnostic from Tdoc t join rel_BELONGS_TO b on b.src_id=t.node_id join AgendaItem ai on ai.node_id=b.dst_id
join rel_MODERATED_BY mo on mo.src_id=t.node_id join Company c on c.node_id=mo.dst_id
where t.summaryType='FL' and ai.agendaNumber like '7.1%' group by c.node_id order by flCount desc,c.companyName
authored_numeric_startswith_7_1.count_unit: original count(t), each original matched path; distinct is a separate diagnostic
